num_real_activities: <int> Number of real activities in the project, excluding the fictitious start and end activities.
num_activities_total: <int> Total number of activities including the fictitious project-start (activity 0) and project-end (activity num_real_activities+1) activities.
num_resources: <int> Number of partially renewable resources available in the project.
max_project_duration: <int> Maximum allowed project duration, serving as the deadline by which the project-end activity must start.

activities.id: <int> Unique identifier of the activity, where 0 is the project-start and num_real_activities+1 is the project-end.
activities.processing_time: <int> Number of consecutive time periods required to complete the activity once it starts.

temporal_constraints.from_activity: <int> Identifier of the first activity in the constrained pair.
temporal_constraints.to_activity: <int> Identifier of the second activity in the constrained pair.
temporal_constraints.time_lag: <int> Minimum required difference between the start time of to_activity and the start time of from_activity, where negative values impose a maximum separation.

resources.resource_id: <int> Unique identifier of the partially renewable resource.
resources.Pi_k: <list[int], length varies> Designated subset of time periods from the planning horizon during which this resource tracks consumption.
resources.capacity: <int> Maximum total consumption allowed for this resource across all activities over its designated period subset.
resources.demands: <dict, key: '{activity_id}'> Per-period resource consumption of each activity for this resource during periods in the designated subset.
